findings.title: Article h1 self-link target is not authenticated
findings.evidence: All three h1 href values can change to /research/ while checker returns PASS in normal and -O. The actual original h1 values are correct.

findings.title: Research navigation target is not authenticated
findings.evidence: All three visible Research links can change from /research/ to /blog/ while checker returns PASS in normal and -O. The actual original navigation values are correct.

archive_utility_hardening_notes: Direct utility accepts integral float member bytes, integral float depth and duplicate identical container declarations; full authenticated consumer pins exact original inventory bytes and rejects a changed inventory. These are not demonstrated authenticated source bypasses.
